Subject: PrivDeploy tier breakdown & flexible platform fee options

Hi Michael —

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. As promised, attached is a compact breakdown of Private Deployment (VPC/on-prem) options tailored to Caravel Health:

- Tier A (Pilot): 2 operator licenses, 1 site license, 3 months pilot pricing (reduced platform fee)
- Tier B (Production): site-based operator license bundle, staggered platform fee amortization over 12 months
- Add-ons: Observability retention, Premium SRE on-call, Air-gapped packaging

Two items to call out up front:
1) Platform fee flexibility — we can amortize the platform fee across the first 12 months or offer a 20% one-time entry discount for pilots that convert to a 24‑month committed contract.
2) Support tiers — standard 9x5 with 4hr P1 response, and enhanced 24x7 with 1hr P1 and regular on‑call rotation.

Questions for you before we draft the SOW:
- Do you prefer amortization (lower monthly cadence) or an up-front discounted pilot?
- Any mandatory procurement constraints (purchase orders, PO cadence, invoice net terms)?

I also attached a draft SOW for your legal/ops to review — please feel free to share and I’ll loop in our legal if we hit redlines. Happy to hop on a call to walk through the pricing math.

Best,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

3) Observability add-on — what's the retention delta (days) between standard and add-on, and can that be toggled post-deployment?

Procurement also needs estimated invoice schedule (quarterly vs monthly) and PO language. Can you send a short note I can share?

Michael —

Thanks for the questions; answering inline below. Cutting to what will help procurement/FP&A evaluate quickly.

1) Per-region operator counts: we can absolutely offer per-region operator licenses. For Caravel's configuration (3 clusters), proposed approach: 1 site license covering core control plane + per-region operator bundles (you only pay for active regions). We'll include a clause to add/remove region operator counts at quarter boundaries to avoid churn.

2) Amortization + conversion discount: yes — if you select amortized billing during pilot and sign a 24‑month commitment within 90 days of pilot completion, we'll honor a 15% conversion credit applied to the remaining platform fee balance. (Note: amortized pilots cannot stack with the one-time 20% up-front pilot discount.)

3) Observability retention: standard is 30 days; add-on moves to 365 days (configurable). Retention can be toggled but changes are applied at monthly billing boundaries.

Procurement asks we can pre-fill: invoice cadence (monthly), net 60 terms (we can consider net 45 for Enterprise customers), and PO reference field. I'll attach a short procurement note after internal alignment (see attachment).

Next steps I propose:
- We (Redwood) prepare a short, procurement-friendly invoice stub and term summary to share with your PO team.
- If those terms look good, Marissa can run a final SOW catch and draft the DocuSign package.

Want to set up a 30min call tomorrow to finalize?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
